snippet.title: Project Afterfall 1.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
PROJECT AFTERFALL LAUNCHES INTO VERSION 1.0 ON NOVEMBER 3, 2026!

🎮 Wishlist / play the free demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360890/Project_Afterfall/

Final release will be available on Steam and GOG.

Project Afterfall is a story-rich survival-strategy RPG/card battler blending retro-futuristic urban fantasy with Slavic folklore.

Build, explore, fight, recruit companions and make choices that shape the fate of your people.
